description: Cross-file process bug (GenServer self-call through an indirection). The seed makes `Projection.metadata/1` look up the parent session's title with `Tackle.Session.Catalog.get/1`. Only projection.ex changes; what makes it wrong is in catalog.ex: the catalog itself calls `Projection.metadata/1` (through `summary_for/1`) while it rebuilds its index inside its own `handle_continue(:rebuild)` and `handle_call({:rebuild, _})`.

edits.replace:
parent_session_id: parent_session_id(projection),
      parent_title: parent_title(projection)
    }
  end

  # Listings show which session a sub-session was branched from.
  defp parent_title(projection) do
    with id when is_binary(id) <- parent_session_id(projection),
         {:ok, %{title: title}} <- Tackle.Session.Catalog.get(id) do
      title
    else
      _other -> nil
    end
  end

issues.description: Tackle.Session.Catalog rebuilds its index inside its own callbacks (handle_continue(:rebuild) at startup, handle_call({:rebuild, _})): the per-session index tasks call summary_for/1 -> Projection.metadata/1, which now makes a GenServer.call back to the catalog. The catalog is blocked waiting for those tasks, so the call is never answered: every sub-session indexed from its journal stalls until the task is killed after rebuild_session_timeout (2 s) and is then skipped, so sub-sessions vanish from the catalog after a restart or reindex. Session journals also call Projection.metadata/1 on every summary, so they now block on (and exit with) a busy or absent catalog.
